description: This file defines the 'JobTitle' class within the 'FilterField' namespace of the OrangeHRM reporting module. It implements filtering logic based on job title entities, including adding conditions to a query builder, retrieving entity aliases, and converting internal data to an array format.

classes.name: JobTitle
classes.description: Represents a filter field for job titles within the reporting system, allowing addition of SQL conditions and conversion of job title data for report output.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds a WHERE condition to the query builder based on the operator and selected value.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the list of entity aliases used in the query, here 'employee'.

methods.name: toArrayXValue
methods.description: Converts the internal value (likely an ID) to a structured array with job title ID and label.
